{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "PROMPT / PRD: Build a premium clean static website for a restaurant event directory called “TableNotes Weekender” — a curated Notion-inspired guide for food pop-ups, supper clubs, chef collabs, tasting nights, jazz brunches, bakery drops, wine dinners, and small neighborhood food events. It must feel like Notion meets an elegant restaurant guide: clean white/cream background, soft gray borders, calm typography, structured blocks, database-style cards, subtle icons, sticky side navigation, minimal but polished. This is NOT an app with backend. It is a static front-end website only, use mock/sample content in local arrays/json, no login, no database, no maps API, no real booking API, no payment, no live data. Use React and GSAP for tasteful entrance animations, scroll reveals, hover effects, and micro-interactions. Overall vibe: clean, editorial, organized, trustworthy, foodie, premium but not flashy. Page goal: help visitors discover restaurant events in one beautiful directory and encourage them to browse categories / featured events. WEBSITE STRUCTURE: 1) Header / Navbar: left logo mark like a small rounded square with fork/calendar icon and text TableNotes Weekender. Center nav links: Featured, Directory, Neighborhoods, Chefs, FAQ. Right side CTA button “Browse Events”. Header should be sticky with translucent blur and thin border. Use hover underline or pill hover effects. 2) Hero Section: large Notion-style page header with breadcrumb text “Restaurant Event Directory / Summer 2026”. Big headline: “Find the best restaurant events happening this weekend.” Subheadline: “A clean curated directory of pop-ups, tasting menus, chef takeovers, wine nights, brunch specials, and limited-seat dining experiences.” Add two CTA buttons: “Explore Directory” and “View Featured Picks”. On the right create a large glass/card dashboard mockup, not an image dependency: a mini directory preview with database rows, tags like Pop-up, Wine Dinner, Brunch, Vegan, Chef Collab, and status pills like Few Seats, New, Sold Out. Add floating small cards with sample stats: “42 curated events”, “18 neighborhoods”, “12 chef collabs”, “Updated weekly” but static. Use GSAP stagger reveal for hero text/cards. 3) Trust / Context Bar: small row of editorial statements: “Handpicked listings”, “No noisy ads”, “Neighborhood-first”, “Static sample content”. Make it look like Notion callout blocks. 4) Featured Events Section: cards for 6 premium events with mock data: event name, restaurant name, date, time, neighborhood, price range, cuisine, tags, short description, small badge. Example events can be invented: Midnight Ramen Counter, Coastal Oyster Hour, Garden Table Supper Club, Vinyl Jazz Brunch, Fire & Fermentation Taco Night, Patisserie Morning Drop. Cards must have strong hover effects: lift, border highlight, soft shadow, tag color shift, small arrow movement. No booking functionality, just static buttons like “View Details”. 5) Directory Section: important complex part. Create Notion database inspired layout with left filter/sidebar and main grid/table. Since static only, filters can be visual/non-functional or simple front-end state filtering using local mock content; no external services. Sidebar categories: Event Type, Cuisine, Price, Mood, Neighborhood, Date Window. Main area includes toggle-looking tabs: “Gallery”, “List”, “Calendar Preview” but keep them static or simple UI state. Include at least 12 event cards/rows with rich mock content. Make it feel like a directory website, not a single restaurant page. Include search-style input visually; if implemented, it can filter local sample content only. 6) Neighborhood Guide Section: clean grid of neighborhood cards: Downtown, Old Market, Riverside, Arts District, Little Italy, Garden Quarter, Midtown, Harbor Walk. Each card has number of events, vibe text, best for tags. Hover effects with animated border / background tint using GSAP or CSS. 7) Chef & Host Spotlight: editorial section with 4 hosts/chefs/restaurants, using placeholder initials/abstract blocks instead of real images if needed. Include quote snippets and specialty. Layout like Notion profile cards. 8) Event Detail Preview Section: design a beautiful static detail panel showing what clicking an event would look like, but it can be displayed on-page. Include title, date/time, venue, menu highlights, dietary notes, seating note, price range, tags, and a clean “Save for later” visual button that does not require account. Make it very polished. 9) Timeline / Weekend Planner: horizontal or vertical timeline for Friday, Saturday, Sunday with event blocks. Use GSAP scroll animations and hover expansion. 10) Editorial Callout: “How we curate” with 3 steps: Scout, Verify details, Publish weekly picks. Keep it static. 11) FAQ Section: accordion-style interaction is allowed using front-end state only. Questions: Is this a booking platform? Are listings real-time? Can restaurants submit events? Do I need an account? Make answers clearly say this is a curated/static demo directory and sample content is used. 12) Footer: clean Notion-like footer with columns: Directory, Categories, Neighborhoods, About. Include newsletter-looking input but it should be visual only or static, no backend submission. Add text “Static preview site — sample listings only.” DESIGN REQUIREMENTS: clean Notion reference, lots of whitespace, off-white #F7F6F2, white cards, charcoal text, muted gray borders, accent color sage green or warm amber. Use rounded corners, subtle shadows, database/table style, pill tags, small icons, neat grid. Typography should feel modern: maybe Inter/Geist style. Make responsive for mobile, tablet, desktop. On mobile, directory filters collapse into horizontal chips; cards stack nicely. INTERACTION REQUIREMENTS: GSAP animations for page load, hero card stagger, scroll reveal sections, hover micro-interactions on cards/buttons/tags, smooth anchor navigation. No heavy animations, keep clean and professional. Buttons and cards should have hover effects. Optional: use CSS transitions for minor hovers and GSAP for section reveals. TECH REQUIREMENTS: React static front-end. Components should be organized: Header, Hero, FeaturedEvents, Directory, Neighborhoods, ChefSpotlight, DetailPreview, PlannerTimeline, FAQ, Footer. Data should be local mock arrays only. No backend, no API calls, no auth, no database, no external map services. If images are needed use CSS gradients, placeholder blocks, or local-friendly placeholder styling; do not depend on external image services. FINAL DELIVERABLE: a complete static responsive restaurant event directory landing site that looks production-quality, complex, clean, Notion-inspired, with realistic mock restaurant event content, GSAP animations, hover effects, and polished UI.",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",

  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
